construct: flex-direction that VARIES on one enum axis (column at the default value, row on the other) — the fluent.card orientation shape
why: Uniform-or-nothing layout enrichment dropped flex-direction on ANY component with an orientation-style axis, so the DEFAULT (column) variant drew the emitters' horizontal default — the rejected fluent.card census set glued its preview and header side by side on both surfaces. The base value plus a layoutByProp override is the schema's own v7 spelling.

canvas.note: the default variant stacks vertically; the horizontal variant rides layoutByProp and compiles per variant (resolveLayout)
